description: This file defines the `ProcessingService` class, which provides methods for processing CSV and JSONL datasets, including steps like dropping missing values, deduplication, and uppercasing string fields. It manages reading input files, applying transformation steps, and writing processed data to output files.

classes.name: ProcessingService
classes.description: Service class responsible for processing datasets in CSV or JSONL format, applying transformation steps, and outputting cleaned datasets.

methods.name: None __init__(self, storage: StorageService)
methods.description: Initializes the processing service with a storage backend.

methods.name: str _detect_format(self, path: Path)
methods.description: Detects the file format based on the file extension (csv or jsonl).

methods.name: Tuple[List[str],Iterable[Dict[str,object]]] _iter_rows(self, path: Path)
methods.description: Generates an iterable of rows from the input dataset, returning headers and data rows.

methods.name: Dict[str,object]|None _apply_steps(self, row: Dict[str, object], steps: List[str])
methods.description: Applies transformation steps such as dropna and uppercase_strings to individual rows.

methods.name: tuple[Path,int] process(self, filename: str, steps: List[str], chunk_size: int = 1000)
methods.description: Main method that processes a dataset file with specified steps, writes output to a CSV, and returns the output path and number of processed rows.
